name: C*Core Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: C*Core Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a chip design company in China. The company offers custom chip technology services, such as IP products and SoC platform; automotive electronics and industrial control products, including microcontrollers, DSP, security and smart cards, and mixed-signal chip; and information technology innovation and information security products comprising cloud-to-device information security, information technology computer peripherals, biometrics and consumer electronics, financial POS, and quantum/quantum-resistant security.
